understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is horizontal via MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT, then gravity automatically carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, entering a new section, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK removes a targeted breakable tile without moving the player or advancing the rising-platform timer; clicks should open useful fall paths. Landing on spikes ends the attempt. UNDO reverses the previous action. Each level allows two attempts with up to 50 turns, and landing previews plus corridor_scan indicate safe and productive destinations.
